To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Twitter is an ideal source for real time event detection.
event detection in Twitter is a challenging task, because of the unique properties of the Twitter data.

event detection from Twitter is a challenging task due to the large volume and the noisy nature of Twitter streams, and that the performance of the proposed event detection techniques is highly dependent on the event type and detection task, and the used features and detection method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the detection of events from Twitter streams.
event detection techniques from Twitter streams and their applications.
the detection of events that unfold over space, time and/or social networks, such as natural disasters, political events, or the spreading of diseases.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the event detection problem is not yet solved.
event detection in Twitter is a very active area of research, which is still in its infancy.
Twitter has become a very popular source of information and a very useful source of information for event detection.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a survey of event detection techniques from Twitter streams.
we have presented a survey of techniques that have been used to detect events from Twitter.
we have developed a novel framework for detecting events in Twitter streams, which has been evaluated on a real dataset.
The main takeaway from our work is that
event detection from Twitter is a complex problem, requiring a combination of various techniques.
the performance of event detection techniques is highly sensitive to the features used.
there is no single best method for detecting events in Twitter streams.
